scope: Results of the actual TuxBox ray ALU lowering in a host compute shader. LLVM assembled the four input instructions for gfx1013. Expected words were independently computed for the inputs below.
operations: v_mad_f32, separately rounded product and sum, cancellation and ordinary product
v_mad_legacy_f32, both signed zero times infinity and NaN times zero, plus 2
v_cvt_i32_f32_sdwa, signed conversion to padded high byte for -37.5 and 8.75
v_cmp_neq_f32, unordered NaN and signed zero comparisons
